name: Teyo, Diamondblade Mage
description: An Echoverse Teyo Verada who became a diamondblade assassin after harnessing diamondstorms.

timeline.summary: Teyo witnesses a diamondstorm tear apart his village and resolves to harness its power.
timeline.quote: After witnessing a diamondstorm tear apart his childhood village, Teyo was determined to find a way to harness that destructive power himself.
